epics.title: Dossier Report Access Control
epics.jtbd: When an analytical report is generated, I want its access restricted based on the user's department and courses, so that closed reports are not globally accessible.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Defect rate in closed document access
requirements: R1: The dossier document list generated for the PDF export must filter out documents that the user does not have department and course access to.

slices.title: Fix Unfiltered fetching of dossier documents in PDF export
slices.jtbd: When implementing the dossier PDF export for this epic, I want the document list to be filtered by user access, so that closed information is not leaked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am a user downloading an exported Employee Dossier PDF
When the PDF iterates over the documents on page 2
Then the list of documents must be filtered according to the current user's department and course, similar to how it is filtered during initial generation.
Given I write an integration test for PDF generation
When a user without access requests the PDF
Then the generated document list should exclude the closed documents.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero unfiltered documents in PDF export

epics.title: Fallback Password Configuration
epics.jtbd: When the external LMS fails, I want to use my autonomous fallback account with a known password, so that I can continue accessing the archive.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Successful local DB authentications during LMS failure
requirements: R1: The system must successfully authenticate and grant access using local fallback credentials when the external Moodle LMS fails.

slices.title: Fix fallback to local DB auth during external LMS failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing fallback authentication for this epic, I want the local auth flow to successfully grant access, so that users can log in when the LMS is down.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Moodle API is unreachable or returns an error
When I attempt to log in with valid local credentials via the fallback mechanism
Then the system should authenticate me and grant access.
Given I write an integration test for fallback login
When the LMS throws LmsServerException
Then the local credentials successfully authenticate the user.
